newsitem.title: USA: IKON Q3 trimmed by transformation effort.
newsitem.headline: IKON Q3 trimmed by transformation effort.

text.p: IKON Office Solutions Inc said Wednesday costs of its business transformation efforts totaled $23 million in the third quarter, ended June 30, cutting net incolme to $30.1 million, or $0.19 per share.
It said earnings per share from continuing operations were $0.30, excluding transformation costs, adding the results meet the revised earnings expectations announced in mid-June.

At that time IKON said it was lowering third quarter expectations due to short-term issues related to the acceleration of its business transformation process. Earnings per share from continuing operations for the same quarter in 1996 were $0.32, excluding transformation costs.

"The focus of our transformation, which will be substantially completed by October 1998, is to change our infrastructure and processes so that we can take full advantage of the high-growth, service-oriented markets in which we compete," said chief executive John Stuart.

He said "IKON continues to demonstrate strong revenue growth, and our business remains healthy. As we commented in June, we did underestimate the short-term impact of accelerated transformation on our copier business."
